# Remediation and Prevention Plan

*Generated by `python -m hcls docs` (run 2026-10-21T20:23:18Z, commit 26d0c9f4). As-of date 2026-10-21. Evidence comes from `outputs/gold/` (scorecard, backfill simulation, validator report, alerts). Effort figures are planning estimates for the owner to confirm. Do not edit by hand.*

## 1. The plan in plain language

- **28 Critical and High findings, grouped into 9 root causes.** Each has an owner, an action, a risk and a rollback (section 2). None is left without a plan (section 3).
- **Backfill will not repair history.** On a copy, matching recovers **0 of 40** missing medicines and **0 of 123** unlinked visits. The source was verified unchanged. The fix is at the source, plus clinician and clerical review.
- **Validators would have blocked the problems at entry.** 49 checks, each tied to the issue it prevents (section 5).
- **Monitoring is defined.** Latest run: **ALERT**, 5 alerts (5 threshold).
- **Nothing here is deployed to production.** The Databricks jobs and the deploy workflow are defined and dry-run only; a human approval gate sits in front of any release (section 6).

## 2. Remediation matrix

| # | Issue | Action | Owner | Effort | Risk | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | Approved amount blank on open claims (C01) | **Accept as by-design**. Report the 90 blanks as pipeline (estimated). Label the field 'pending decision' so a blank is never read as lost data. | Finance + Claims team | S | Low | None needed: no data is changed. |
| G2 | Broken links between tables (A02, A30, A38, A03, A01) | **Fix at source, quarantine until fixed**. Conform patient, bill, claim and prescription keys at the ETL mapping step; add foreign keys with a same-patient check. Until fixed, never join claims to bills (D-004). | ETL owner | L | High | Keep the old key column beside the new one for two releases; version the mapping table; re-run reconciliation before and after. |
| G3 | Visits without an appointment (C02) | **Fix at source; backfill not viable**. Make the appointment reference mandatory, or add an explicit walk-in type. The matching simulation recovers none of the 123, so a clerical review of the source is the only route for history. | Registration / EHR owner | M | Medium | Feature-flag the new constraint; load in warn-only mode for one week first. |
| G4 | Medical records with prescribed_meds = None (C03) | **Clinician review, then fix at source**. The simulation applies no automatic fill: of 40, one has only an inactive prescription and two conflict with the treatment plan. 20 name a drug in the plan, so those go to the clinician first. Add an explicit 'no medication' code. | Clinical owner | M | Medium | Write corrections to a separate table with a reviewer id; never overwrite the original value. |
| G5 | Placeholder and orphan ids, duplicate patients | **Quarantine, then enforce foreign keys**. Move rows with placeholder patient ids (0, negative, 88888, 9999x) to a quarantine table for resolution; add FK constraints; review the duplicate patient ids for a merge. | Registration / EHR owner + ETL owner | M | Medium | Quarantine is a move with a log of original positions, so a restore script puts rows back. |
| G6 | Dates out of order (A24, A28) | **Flag, then correct at source**. Discharge before admission (152) and prescription end before start (118) cannot be repaired by swapping dates (that is a guess, D-012). Flag, route to the owning team, add date-order checks. | Clinical operations | M | Low | Corrections go in an adjustment table; originals stay. |
| G7 | Billing and claim amounts (A09, A10, A11, A44, A07) | **Quarantine (hold) and review**. Negative totals, approved above submitted, paid above responsibility and totals that do not add up are held out of reconciliation (as the 4 DQ Hold claims already are) and reviewed by Finance. | Finance + Billing system owner | S | Low | Held rows stay in place and are only labelled; release them by clearing the flag. |
| G8 | Administered unit differs from prescribed unit (A31) | **Defer until G2 is fixed**. The administration row points at a prescription of a different patient (A30), so the unit comparison is meaningless today. Re-test after the key fix; then standardise units. | Pharmacy / Clinical owner | S | Low | None needed: no data is changed. |
| G9 | Bills raised for Cancelled or No-Show appointments (A12) | **Compliance review**. 81 of 249 bills sit on appointments that did not take place. This could be real over-billing or the broken link again. Compliance to review a sample against the source system. | Compliance | M | High | Review only; no data is changed. Any refund waits for the answer to the over-charging question. |

## 4. Backfill simulation (on a copy; the source is never changed)

C03 is filled from Prescriptions (same patient, prescription active on the record date, same doctor = High, different doctor = Medium). A match is rejected if the treatment plan names a different drug. C02 is matched to an appointment for the same patient within one day. Only High (C02) and High or Medium (C03) are applied.

| rule_id | records_failing_before | proposals_high | proposals_medium | proposals_low_or_ambiguous | conflicts_with_plan | no_match | applied_to_copy | records_failing_after | recovered_pct | source_unchanged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C03 | 40 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 37 | 0 | 40 | 0 | True |
| C02 | 123 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 123 | 0 | 123 | 0 | True |


What the numbers mean:

- **C03:** only 3 of 40 records have any prescription candidate at all, and none is both consistent and from the same doctor. 2 candidates contradict the treatment plan, so applying them would put a wrong drug on a record.
- **C02:** 123 of 123 visits have no appointment for the same patient within a day. The patient ids themselves are unreliable (Sprint 2), which is why matching fails.
- Row-level proposals: `outputs/gold/backfill_c03.csv`, `outputs/gold/backfill_c02.csv`.

## 6. Deployment and monitoring

Databricks jobs (`databricks/jobs/`, notebooks in `databricks/notebooks/`):

| Job | Schedule | Runs | Purpose | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dq_daily` | Every day 02:00 UTC | ingest, clean, dq, alerts | Data-quality scorecard and alerts | 30 min |
| `recon_weekly` | Mondays 06:00 UTC | ingest, clean, recon | Finance reconciliation workbook and brief | 10 min (SLA alert at 5) |
| `audit_nightly` | Every day 03:00 UTC | all, alerts | Full rebuild of every output for the audit trail | 45 min |

All jobs retry twice, time out, and email on failure. A run longer than 5 minutes on `recon_weekly` raises an alert.

Pipeline (`.github/workflows`): 1 code quality, 2 unit tests, 3 data tests, 4 integration + coverage gate, **5 approval gate (`production` environment, required reviewer)**, 6 simulated deploy (dry-run of the job definitions, release artefacts). Stages 1-4 run on every pull request; 5-6 run only after a merge to main.

Alerts (`outputs/alerts.json`): a Critical rule failing on more than 5% of records, a rule's failures moving by more than 10% between runs, reconciliation over 5 minutes.

- [ ] Backfill and quarantine steps run on a copy first; before and after counts match the simulation report.
- [ ] Rollback tested: the restore step was run once in staging and the row counts returned to the originals.
- [ ] Validators run in warn-only mode for one week before they start rejecting rows.
- [ ] Monitoring in place: daily scorecard job, alert recipients confirmed (Finance for Critical rules).
- [ ] Owners named and effort accepted for every group in the matrix.

## 8. Answers to Key Questions 5 and 8

**5. Can we fix it?** Partly. C01 needs no fix (by design). The broken links need a source fix by the ETL owner. C02 and C03 cannot be backfilled from the data we have, only prevented from now on and reviewed by people. Placeholder ids and out-of-order dates go to quarantine and review.

**8. How do we prevent it?** Ingest validators (section 5), database constraints (not null, foreign keys with a same-patient check), a daily data-quality job with alerts (section 6), and a data contract with the claims and registration systems.

## Reproduce

```bash
python -m hcls backfill && python -m hcls validate && python -m hcls alerts && python -m hcls docs
```
